current.text: He comes off the bench for Phoenix, behind Jalen Green, Devin Booker, Dillon Brooks and Miles Bridges in a crowded guard and wing group.
Most of his 2025-26 production came from starts while other Phoenix guards were injured. His minutes fell to about 23 a game once Green, Brooks and Booker were all back.
He re-signed with Phoenix on a 4 year, 40 million USD contract.
He only pays off if a guard ahead of him gets hurt. If Green, Booker or Brooks misses time, he would start and play about 30 minutes, which would lift him about three tiers.
As a bench player the experts value him around rank 150. They say his ESPN rank of 100 is too high.
Ben from Locked On Suns thinks he should start over Jalen Green, but expects the team to start Green.

durable.text: Ben from Locked On Suns rates him as a better three point shooter, ball handler and defender than Jalen Green.

note: Yahoo ranks him 125th and ESPN 100th, at about 1 USD on both sites. Experts put him near 150th, which is just outside the 144 players our league drafts, so do not spend more than 1 USD on him and leaving him on waivers is fine. His projection gives threes (2.7) and steals with a solid FT%, but a 42% FG% hurts. Early in the season, watch the health of Green, Booker and Brooks, because one injury would put him back near 30 minutes and make him a quick FAB add.
